data.gender_notes: Harvani is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Harvani is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit word 'har' meaning 'abundance' and 'vani' meaning 'voice'. This name signifies a fertile and abundant being, often associated with the voice of nature and the rains that bring life to the land. The name Harvani carries the meaning “Fertile, Abundant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Harvani usually hope their child will grow to embody fertile, abundant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
